changes: Bold Greek in equations: \boldsymbol{\sigma} and \bm{} give bold italic, \mathbf{} bold upright, Greek included.
$...$ and $$...$$ take the same LaTeX: inline maths with \bar, \dot or \lceil is set as an equation.
Sans-serif equations (Document fonts > Equations) to match sans-serif text.
Equation editor: select characters and press Text (Ctrl+Shift+E) to set them upright, such as the max of a subscript.
Yes and no labels go beside a decision's exit, connector labels stay on the page, and Elsevier page sizes (90, 140, 190 mm).
Sharper equations in the editors on scaled screens, and space around = and + in inline maths.
